responsibility: This small subtarget header adjusts the bare-metal 68020 ELF configuration’s startup-file handling. Its main job is to override the default ELF STARTFILE_SPEC so GCC does not inject crt0.o, leaving startup code selection to embedded linker scripts while still arranging for crtbegin.o. It is therefore a focused ABI/configuration companion for a “naked” 68020 ELF environment rather than a general code-generation file.
